## Implement seqconsistency Phase-1 MVP package

```
level: high
date: 2026-10-21
```

### description

Implement a complete, pip-installable Python package `seqconsistency` that assesses
whether multiple sequencing datasets (FASTQ SE/PE, coordinate-sorted BAM; profiles
paired_short / merged_short / ont / hifi) are structurally valid, technically consistent,
and poolable under an explicit policy, with deterministic bounded-memory sampling,
Wasserstein + Jensen–Shannon pairwise comparisons, five explicit-path Parquet outputs,
provenance JSON, optional HTML report, comprehensive tests, benchmarks with measured
results, and full documentation.
